channelTitle: Grandma June's oddest bedtime habit actually has a real name
hook: Rubbing oil in your belly button before bed sounds made up, but this old habit has been around a lot longer than the internet trend that just rediscovered it.
remedy: A drop of castor oil massaged into the belly button before bed is an old folk practice, based on the idea that the area sits near the digestive system, some families used it as part of an evening routine for general comfort.
steps: Warm a drop of castor oil between your fingertips
Gently massage it into and around the belly button
Do this as part of your evening routine before bed
caution: Evidence for this specific practice is mostly anecdotal, not clinical - treat it as a gentle ritual, not a treatment, and see a doctor for real digestive concerns.
cta: Had you heard of this one before, or is this brand new to you? Tell Grandma June.
